title: Behave
author: Robert M. Sapolsky
summary: Robert Sapolsky works backward from a single human act, seconds earlier to evolutionary history, to explain how brain, hormones, childhood and culture shape behavior, especially aggression, cooperation and morality.
readIf: you want a broad, dense, funny deep dive into the science of why humans act as they do.
skipIf: you want a short, light read, since it is long and technical in places.
